other_conditions: Applicant must not be employed in any government or semi-government job
Applicant must not be a loan defaulter in any bank
Only environment‑friendly business proposals are acceptable (businesses related to alcohol, drugs, or polythene are not allowed)
If the applicant is disabled, the disability percentage must be at least 40%
benefits_summary: Provides subsidized loans up to ₹5,00,000 with up to 40% subsidy, low‑interest rate of 6%, loan guarantee facilities and entrepreneurship training.
